assets.name: food
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. The reference is the game's existing dark slate-and-brass resource bar. Deliver one isolated resource symbol ONLY as a transparent PNG. Preserve the selected symbol's silhouette, warm gold/brown palette, painted Warcraft-style highlights, and compact readable proportions. Remove ALL slate/black rectangular backdrop, frame, border, text, numbers, baseline, pedestal, and detached cast shadow. Real transparent alpha, never a checkerboard drawn in the pixels. Center the symbol in a square canvas; symbol should occupy about 85% of the canvas height and be readable at 28–32px. No scene, no UI panel, no lettering. Crisp edges and broad coherent details; avoid extra ornamentation. Extract/recreate ONLY the tied bundle of golden wheat at the far left of the reference. Keep its stems, bound bundle and wheat ears. Nothing else.

assets.name: culture
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one standalone game HUD resource icon. The reference is the game's dark slate-and-brass resource bar; match the warm gold, bronze, detailed but compact painted Warcraft-style resource symbols. Create a small OPEN BOOK with cream parchment pages, warm dark brown binding and restrained gold edges, a clear central spine and two readable page masses. It represents culture/knowledge and replaces the old stone monument symbol. No text, no runes, no page lettering, no icons on the pages. Centered, square canvas, book occupies about 85% width. Designed to read clearly at 28–32px, strong simple silhouette. Genuinely transparent background with transparent alpha. No dark square, slate tile, frame, border, pedestal, detached shadow, UI, numbers or scenery.
